news.title: Jim Cramer says don't chase the AI rebound just yet. Here's what needs to happen first
news.summary: CNBC’s Jim Cramer warned investors against rushing back into AI stocks quite yet.

news.title: Jim Cramer says the recent AI stock sell-off echoes a crucial lesson from the 1987 market crash
news.summary: CNBC’s Jim Cramer said the 1987 stock market crash offers an important lesson that can be applied to the recent AI sell-off.

news.title: Apple's iPhone Duo is proving itself the catalyst that Jim Cramer said it would be
news.summary: Preorders of Apple's iPhone Duo are proving Jim Cramer right, as early indications show strong demand.

news.title: Apple announces product launch event for Oct. 28. Analysts expect touchscreen laptop
news.summary: Apple sent invitations for an event next week, calling it "Pro and tell."

news.title: Investors are buying on Monday despite fear the AI trade nightmare scenario is far from over
news.summary: Here are the key things investors need to know to start the trading day.

news.title: Google says it can build data centers the right way. Some experts and residents are skeptical
news.summary: Google says its Minnesota AI data center will add clean energy to the grid and protect ratepayers. Experts question whether grid upgrades are needed.

news.title: Women may be at greater risk of AI job losses. Telephone switch operators and PCs show why
news.summary: The history of technological progress suggests that as AI spreads, the employment impact will hit women more than men.

news.title: Robot factories and hypersonic missiles: JPMorgan Chase's first $5 billion of defense investments
news.summary: With $5 billion already deployed off its balance sheet, JPMorgan Chase is racing ahead on direct investments in defense tech, hardware and supply chains.

news.title: Elon Musk says he'll give a SpaceX share to every child in America next year
news.summary: The SpaceX boss said Monday that he'll give one of his company shares to every child in the U.S. next year. He didn't say how the share giveaway would happen.

news.title: China's CXMT shares fall nearly 8% as investors look past chipmaker's profit turnaround
news.summary: CXMT shares fell nearly 8% on Monday after the company released its earnings forecast for the first nine months of 2026.

news.title: Anthropic commits 5% of shares to new public benefit fund that could address AI job disruption
news.summary: The Claude maker said that establishing the fund as an LLC will provide greater flexibility in how the money is used.

news.title: Data-Center Firm Elice Plunges 32% in Debut After Korea IPO
news.summary: Data-center infrastructure company Elice Inc. plunged in its trading debut on South Korea’s tech-heavy Kosdaq market after raising 201 billion won ($151 million) in the bourse’s biggest initial public offering this year.

news.title: CATL’s Valuation Gap Highlights Investor Divide as Earnings Near
news.summary: Contemporary Amperex Technology Co. Ltd.’s Hong Kong-listed shares have maintained a considerable premium over their Shenzhen-traded peers after a months-long selloff, underscoring a divide between onshore and offshore investors ahead of the Chinese battery giant’s earnings release.

news.title: Z.AI Founders Worked on Research Funded by China Institute UK Tied to Spies
news.summary: Four founders of one of China’s most promising artificial intelligence companies, Z.AI Co., worked on research in a joint project with a technology institute that the UK government accused of having “very strong ties” to China’s main spy agency, according to publicly available research papers from China and an “espionage alert” from the UK.

news.title: Alger’s Crawford: There’s Skittishness in the Market
news.summary: Ankur Crawford, a Portfolio Manager at Alger and Former Intel Engineer, said recent market nervousness around AI— including concerns tied to CoreWeave—does not reflect the strength of underlying adoption and infrastructure demand. She described a striking gap between stock performance and on-the-ground fundamentals, while noting that returns from AI investment will take time and that debt, supply-...

news.title: Big Take: CoreWeave And The Fragile AI Economy
news.summary: CoreWeave’s debt is rattling some investors. Today on the Big Take podcast, what the company’s financial strain reveals about the AI boom and what lies ahead for cloud infrastructure providers. (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Big Tech Earnings Could Validate AI, Ives Says
news.summary: Dan Ives, partner and senior managing director at Yorkville, Ives, and Company, says the upcoming earnings from major technology companies will be an important test of confidence in AI. He also talks about giving investors a chance to invest in private ai companies.   (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Tenstorrent CEO on New Funding Round, AI Progress
news.summary: Tenstorrent CEO Jim Keller discussed the chip startup’s $1.5 billion funding round, which values the company at about $6.2 billion. He said the company is focused on scaling its Galaxy server program and developing AI intellectual property, rather than pursuing a sale. He speaks with Romaine Bostick & Bailey Lipschultz on "The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Retailers Will Struggle During Earnings Season, Says Meredith Whitney
news.summary: Meredith Whitney, CEO of the Meredith Whitney Advisory Group, says many retailers will struggle during this earnings season because because household costs have been rising since the start of the Iran war. She speaks on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: OpenAI Staffer Charged With Bugging Office Stays Jailed for Now
news.summary: The OpenAI software engineer charged with planting a hidden recording device in one of the company’s offices must remain in jail for the time being, a federal judge ruled.

news.title: Musk Plans to Gift SpaceX Shares to Kids Through Trump Accounts
news.summary: Elon Musk vowed to distribute a share of SpaceX to each child in the US, a multibillion-dollar pledge that adds to a string of sizable donations from the tech industry for the benefit of the American public.

news.title: Eric Schmidt’s 1% Anthropic Stake Set to Pay Massive Windfall
news.summary: Former Google Chief Executive Officer Eric Schmidt owns around 1% of Anthropic PBC thanks to his early investment in the startup, according to people familiar with the matter, setting him up for one of the largest individual windfalls from the company’s imminent public market debut.

news.title: JPMorgan's 2027 Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions
news.summary: David Kelly, chief global strategist at JPMorgan Asset Management, and Stephen Parker, co-head of global investment strategy at JPMorgan Private Bank, discuss their latest Long-Term Capital Market Assumptions report, which projects about 7% annual returns for 60/40 portfolios over the next 10–15 years. They speak on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Intel Asks FCC to Allow Upgrades for Banned Foreign Robots
news.summary: Intel Corp. asked the Federal Communications Commission to make an exception to a recent ban on foreign-made advanced robotics, telling the agency it needs continued access to “niche” equipment critical to US semiconductor manufacturing.

news.title: FTC Requires Publicis to Offer Equal Access to LiveRamp Data
news.summary: The US Federal Trade Commission said it will allow Publicis Groupe SA to complete the $2.2 billion acquisition of LiveRamp Holdings Inc. if the French media giant agrees to offer equal access to the digital advertising platform’s data connectivity services to rivals.

news.title: Goldman's Lynam Isn't Worried About Access to Debt Amid AI Buildout
news.summary: Amanda Lynam, chief credit strategist at Goldman Sachs, says recent widening in AI-related credit spreads resembles an earlier episode but differs because high-yield debt is now leading the move and investors are raising fundamental questions. She speaks on "Bloomberg The Close." (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Tech Stocks Pull S&P 500 Higher as Opportunistic Buyers Step In
news.summary: Chips companies rallied in Monday trading, helping stocks rebound after the worst week for the tech-heavy Nasdaq 100 Index since the tariff turmoil of April 2025.

news.title: Vinted Cracks Down on Looted Goods After French Riots
news.summary: Vinted, a secondhand online marketplace that counts France as one of its largest markets, has seen an influx of listings suspected to contain looted items after riots broke out across the country.

news.title: Japan Launches Probe in First Sampling Mission to a Moon of Mars
news.summary: Japan launched a probe bound for a moon of Mars, giving the nation a head start over China in the race to become the first to return samples from the Red Planet or one of its moons.

news.title: Nscale, Anthropic in Talks for $45 Billion Cloud Computing Deal
news.summary: Nscale Ltd., the AI cloud computing firm, is in talks to sell computing power to Anthropic PBC in a deal that could be worth about $45 billion, according to people familiar with the negotiations.

news.title: AI Firm Nscale Faces Investor Pushback Over IPO Valuation
news.summary: Bloomberg's Brody Ford said that issues facing the IPO of AI firm Nscale are 'endemic' to the larger AI data center industry as developers try to source power and labor and contend with potential delays. Bloomberg's Bailey Lipschultz said that the tone has shifted for AI IPOs as more companies slow down on going public before the end of the year.  (Source: Bloomberg)

news.title: Nscale and Anthropic are reportedly in talks for yet another $45 billion compute deal
news.summary: In August, Nscale and Anthropic announced a $45 billion compute deal. The two companies are reportedly discussing yet another deal of the same magnitude.

news.title: Embedded AI evaluators won’t be an easy solution, Hugging Face’s policy chief says
news.summary: AI labs have staked their reputations on model benchmarking — the supposedly neutral and accurate system of evaluations that are designed to measure whether one AI product is better than another. However, the methods behind these evaluations are complicated and still maturing, said Irene Solaiman, Hugging Face’s chief policy officer, during a discussion at TechCrunch […]

news.title: Microsoft says AI agents are like insider threats as ‘frontier models can’t be trusted’
news.summary: Microsoft wants enterprises to closely watch the agents employees use with systems not controlled by AI labs like OpenAI and Anthropic.

news.title: Amazon is taking its biggest shot at Nvidia yet with new TorchNeuron dev tool
news.summary: Amazon wants to break Nvidia’s hold on PyTorch, the free toolkit used to build most AI apps, so that more developers run their apps on alternative chips like its own.

news.title: Hackers hit AI coding tool OpenCode, running up charges on users’ AI accounts
news.summary: OpenCode is an open source AI coding agent that's become a popular alternative to Claude Code and Cursor. But hackers got into part of its online platform and stole some users’ API keys, and the AI tools it turned to for help kept refusing to look at the malicious code.

news.title: Tolan snags $30M for its AI companion that helps users navigate life
news.summary: AI companion app Tolan has raised another $30 million after attracting more than 250,000 active users.

news.title: Replika’s founder built the AI assistant she pitched at Disrupt 12 years ago
news.summary: Eugenia Kuyda's newest startup Wabi is positioned to take advantage of an idea she had more than a decade ago. Wabi offers a personal AI assistant with a twist, free and downloadable to anyone today.

news.title: Tenstorrent hits $6.2B valuation to scale open-weight AI chips
news.summary: After drawing acquisition interest earlier this year, the Nvidia challenger raised $1.5 billion to remain independent.

news.title: AI assistant startup Town nabs unicorn valuation 4 months after launch
news.summary: AI assistant startup Town nabbed a unicorn valuation on Monday, announcing a $108 million Series B round co-led by Forerunner Ventures and Menlo Ventures.

news.title: Rivian’s CEO says autonomy will enable ‘dramatically different’ vehicle designs
news.summary: Founder and CEO RJ Scaringe said he thinks autonomy will allow his company to build radically different kinds of vehicles than the outdoorsy SUVs and trucks it currently makes.

news.title: Amazon to fund 12 small nuclear reactors at former Indiana coal plant
news.summary: Amazon and X-energy have inked another deal to deploy nuclear power to the grid. This one will generate nearly 1 gigawatt of electricity.

news.title: People are using AI to make their smart TVs dumb again
news.summary: Fed up with ads, tracking, and sluggish interfaces, some smart TV owners are turning to AI agents to strip away bloatware and take back control of their TVs.

news.title: Nvidia launches new open models to run agents in the enterprise and on PCs
news.summary: Nvidia is leaning hard into the trend of enterprise companies wanting to run their own open models in their own data centers and also trying to make on-device, private AI agents a thing.

news.title: Apple updates guidelines to ban nudify apps masquerading as regular apps to pass review
news.summary: The company updated its guidelines with strong language around AI and user-generated content, and how app developers should include enough preventative measures to moderate objectionable or offensive content.

news.title: Musk pledges to give ‘every kid in America’ one of his SpaceX shares
news.summary: Musk's post came just a few hours after Anthropic promised to put 5% of its shares into a new "public benefit fund," which it intends to use to make "large donations to traditional nonprofits or direct distributions to specific populations" after its upcoming IPO.

news.title: Laplace Intelligence red-teams robots and self-driving cars before they hit the real world
news.summary: University of Michigan spinout Laplace Intelligence uses AI agents and interactive simulation to stress-test robots and self-driving vehicles before deployment. The profitable startup is competing in Startup Battlefield at TechCrunch Disrupt, October 13-15 in San Francisco.

news.title: Khosla Ventures doubles down on Even Healthcare to challenge India’s hospital economics
news.summary: Even Healthcare reaches a $300 million valuation in a Khosla Ventures-led round as it plans to expand its hospital network in India.

news.title: Elon Musk’s proposed SpaceX stock giveaway would go into ‘Trump Accounts’
news.summary: President Donald Trump announced this afternoon that Elon Musk's SpaceX shares for children will be given through Trump Accounts. Musk said earlier today that he would give one of his SpaceX shares to "every kid in America" sometime next year. Musk had thanked Trump Account booster Brad Gerstner for "helping enable this," and Trump appeared […]

news.title: The fossil fuel comeback is here
news.summary: The US is building more fossil fuel infrastructure than it has in a decade while renewable energy growth slows down, a new report shows. Electricity demand is also climbing faster than it has in more than a decade with more data centers, factories, and electric vehicles plugging into the grid. Despite those growing demands, the […]

news.title: CoreWeave’s debt is becoming the whole AI industry’s problem
news.summary: CoreWeave had a bad week last week. Its bonds slipped into distressed territory by a common definition - when investors demand 1,000 basis points more in yield than they'd get from government bonds. Last Tuesady Chamath "SPAC King" Palihapitiya noticed the distressed debt, and also asked whether the AI buildout was a private credit bubble. […]

news.title: I tried a $99 plug that promises to track your car and send help when needed — without selling your data
news.summary: My 15-year-old daughter just got her learner's permit, so when I was pitched a new gadget tailored to teen drivers, I was intrigued. The Miles Plug is a small device that plugs into your car's OBD-II port and monitors location, driving habits, and vehicle health, along with emergency accident response and roadside assistance. The idea […]

news.title: Sony’s best noise-canceling earbuds are nearly $100 off today only
news.summary: For a very limited time, Sony’s latest high-end noise-canceling earbuds are actually cheaper than their last-gen counterpart, the WF-1000XM5. B&H Photo is selling Sony’s latest WF-1000XM6 in black for an all-time low of $238 ($92 off) at checkout. Other retailers aren’t currently offering a discount on the XM6. The XM6 are a solid upgrade over […]

news.title: Apple teases MacBook Pro event next week
news.summary: Apple has sent invites to a second product launch this month, and it's scheduled for October 28th at 1PM ET in Los Angeles. At the event, Apple is set to announce new Macs and a refreshed iPad Mini, according to Bloomberg. The big announcement is expected to be a new MacBook Pro with an OLED […]

news.title: Amazon is funding a new nuclear plant in Indiana
news.summary: Amazon has signed an agreement with X-energy and American Electric Power (AEP) to fund the building of a new nuclear energy facility in Indiana. The proposed plant, which would replace the now defunct coal-fueled Breed Generating Station in Fairbanks, Sullivan County, aims to provide up to 960 megawatts of carbon-free energy for both the regional […]

news.title: Apple’s last-gen Mac Mini with the M4 is $150 off
news.summary: Best Buy has a great deal for the rest of the day on the M4 Mac Mini base model that has 16GB RAM and a 256GB SSD. Normally, it doesn’t make a ton of sense to buy the M4 model for its usual $799 price given that the newer, faster M6 version has been available […]

news.title: JB Pritzker thinks AI could help us live to 100 — or threaten us like nukes
news.summary: Today, I’m talking with Illinois Gov. JB Pritzker, who has a lot of thoughts about AI, tech, and privacy. If you’ve been listening to the show, you know that one of my running theories is that those issues are driving a big and maybe kind of unexpected political realignment — and with the midterms coming […]

news.title: Major European mobile carriers are teaming up for a ‘direct’ satellite program without Starlink
news.summary: Deutsche Telekom, Orange, Telefónica, and Vodafone signed a letter of intent saying they're considering a joint bid for spectrum that would support European direct-to-device satellite competition for SpaceX's Starlink.
